{"classification":"real_incident","summary":"GET /api/orders/express-1002 returns 500 (ValueError: day is out of range for month). order_detail() computed the express delivery estimate with placed_at.replace(day=placed_at.day + 2), which fails for orders placed on day 29-31. Fixed with a timedelta.","user_impact":"Every request for express orders placed on day 29-31 of a month fails with 500. The seeded express-1002 is dated the last day of the previous month, so it always fails. Standard orders and the list endpoint are unaffected.","root_cause":"app/main.py:81 in order_detail used placed_at.replace(day=placed_at.day + 2). This raises ValueError when day+2 exceeds the month length. Express-1002's created_at is the previous month's last day, so the failure is deterministic.","evidence":[{"source":"metrics","reference":"five_xx_last_5m","observation":"7 5xx responses, all error_type=ValueError, service_version 3982ab3, route /api/orders/{order_id}."},{"source":"logs","reference":"Loki ERROR trace_id=9d5ffecbb7b0370dc1f699efbd25982c","observation":"ValueError: day is out of range for month, raised at app/main.py line 81 in order_detail, called from get_order line 200."},{"source":"traces","reference":"trace 220cc9ab9c479bfc0547d8048476458b","observation":"orders.build_detail span errored with order.priority=express and order.id=express-1002. The DB select succeeded."},{"source":"code","reference":"app/main.py:61-64,81","observation":"The seed sets express-1002 to the last day of the previous month, and the estimate uses replace(day=day+2)."}],"confidence":0.95,"proposed_action":"patch","changes":[{"file":"app/main.py","description":"Compute estimated_at as placed_at + timedelta(days=2) instead of replace(day=day+2)."},{"file":"tests/test_api.py","description":"Added test_express_estimate_crosses_month_end, which uses a fixed 2026-01-31 date and expects 2026-02-02."}],"tests":{"ran":true,"command":"uv run --frozen pytest -q","passed":true,"summary":"6 passed after the fix. I did not run the new test against the old code; it uses a fixed Jan 31 date, so the old replace(day=33) would raise ValueError."},"verification_requests":["/api/orders/express-1002"],"escalation_reason":null,"final_message":"INC-20260930-130801-ecb8: 5xx on /api/orders/{order_id} (GET /api/orders/express-1002).
Cause: order_detail used replace(day=day+2) for the express ETA, which raises ValueError for orders placed on day 29-31 of a month.
Fix: use placed_at + timedelta(days=2), plus a date-independent regression test. The suite passes (6 tests).
Verdict: real incident, small local patch proposed, replay /api/orders/express-1002 after deploy."}
